title: Hard to see controls
text: Hard to see controls. Normally, products come with instructions or recipes etc. Nothing in this one but at least it is self explanatory.  The "notches" on the controls are extremely hard to see.  No lights. No clicks. Just a best guess and then you cannot go back once it is set.  For capacity, it holds 6 bagel bites.  It is compact which is what I wanted but doing it over again, I would have went with a different brand.
